body.x: AVING News selected ▲Fitbit’s “Fitbit Blaze”, ▲Huawei’s “Jewel”, ▲Casio’s “WSD-F10”, ▲Martian’s “New Smart Watches Collection”, and ▲Breo’s “UME Watch” as the top five smartwatch products showcased at “CES (Consumer Electronic Show) 2016”, the world’s largest IT consumer electronics exhibition, which runs for four days from Wednesday the 6th to Saturday the 9th in Las Vegas.

“Fitbit Blaze”, which was introduced for the first time at CES 2016, comes with various functions, including FitStar™, GPS, PurePulse® heart-rate tracking, and SmartTrack™ automatic exercise recognition, which maximizes exercise capabilities.

“Jewel” is a premium smartwatch created in collaboration with “Swarovski”. It possesses a beautiful design and outstanding performance. It can be connected to iOS-based devices, and users can conveniently receive text messages and alarms/rings for calls. It supports Bluetooth and is equipped with various functions, including a heart-rate monitor. In particular, much effort was put into the design, decorated with 68 Swarovski Zirconia crystals, all dotted around the rose gold-plated case.

The “WSD-F10” is Casio’s first smartwatch that looks like an electronic watch. It is an Android Wear smartwatch with various sensors for outdoor activities. It is waterproof up to 50m and possesses a 1.32-inch circular watch face that shows a user’s level of activity and exercise regimen.

The newly introduced “New Smart Watches Collection” is a smartwatch with fashionable designs and smart functions. With functions that general smartwatches possess, it can create seven VIP groups, and users can assign seven different LED colors to each group’s notifications. By using this function, users can easily tell who sent messages. Furthermore, it provides both the iron-plated stainless band and Italian leather straps.

The “UME Watch” can check users’ mental states by measuring their heart beat and condition, blood oxygen levels, and sleep states. This product is made of sapphire glass, medical stainless, and Italian calf straps, which give an extra flavor of luxury to the design.

“CES”, which is held every year in January by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), is the world’s largest IT consumer electronics exhibition, showcasing global trends in the electronics and IT industry. AVING News, which has sent reporters to CES for 11 years, will introduce various up-to-date technologies and products showcased at CES 2016.
